p: The Trial Balance report reflects interest transactions, including interest accrual, interest posted, interest waiver, and interest refund, and includes all interest activity in balances and daily DR/CR calculations. It also reflects asset owner separation for interest-related activity and balances. For an asset sale on an active loan with no active ownership record, the Trial Balance Summary reports all monetary transactions under the null (PayPal) ownership, while 112601/112603 detail lines reflect the ending balance sale or transfer of ownership. For an asset sale on an active loan with previous inactive ownership records and no active ownership record, the Trial Balance Summary reports all monetary transactions under the null (PayPal) ownership, while 112601/112603 detail lines reflect the ending balance sale or transfer of ownership. For an asset buyback on an active loan with an active ownership record, the Trial Balance Summary reports all monetary transactions under the current ownership, while 112601/112603 detail lines reflect the ending balance buyback or transfer of ownership to PayPal. For an asset buyback on a FRAUD loan with no active ownership record, the Trial Balance Summary reports all monetary transactions under the current ownership, while 112601/112603 detail lines reflect the ending balance buyback or transfer of ownership to PayPal. The Trial Balance summary report can fetch manual journal entry details with asset owner.
